node.title: Re: Unable to flush stdout: Invalid argument
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [bakiperl],

Based on the error message, I think this has something to do with the implicit closing of filehandles that Perl does, in this case the closing of STDOUT when Perl exits (see [rt://57512|#57512] and [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commitdiff/8abddda39a55d116a506c465ef0ccd0f8546b896|8abddda39], which was part of v5.24). Unfortunately, that's all I've got at the moment: In your scripts, apparently Perl can't flush and/or close STDOUT.

If you could boil down your code to a script that is as short as possible but still displays the problem ([id://1177642|SSCCE]), we might be able to better assist.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
